The main takeaway from our work is that
, while DL models may not necessarily be interpretable, the interpretability of their behavior may be conditioned by the design of the model and the post processing.
interpretability of DL models for clinical use can be achieved by designing a model architecture that incorporates domain knowledge and by using appropriate post processing techniques.
